statements.quote: If we are expecting 12% market growth, then we should deliver 18% and plus.
statements.target: Revenue growing at 1.5x of market growth rate

statements.quote: Over long term, we should expect 11% to 13% EBITDA margin. And in the near to mid term, we may expect 12% to 14% EBITDA.
statements.target: 12-14% EBITDA margin near-mid term; 11-13% long term (Cables & Wires)

statements.quote: We are continuing to expand, again, in line with our Project Spring guidance of INR 6,000 crores to INR 8,000 crores capex by financial year 2030.
statements.target: Cumulative capex of INR 6,000-8,000 crores by FY2030 (INR 12-16 billion/yr)

statements.quote: We remain firm on track to achieve our target of greater than 10% contribution from exports by financial year 2030.
statements.target: Exports to exceed 10% of consolidated revenue by FY2030 (currently 5.4% in FY26)

statements.quote: We've committed in Cables & Wires, we will grow at 1.5x of market growth... In FMEG, growing at 1.5x to 2x of market rate, while maintaining a clear focus on margin expansion and progressing towards our EBITDA margin goal of 8% to 10% by FY2030.
statements.target: FMEG EBITDA margin of 8-10% by FY2030; FMEG growth at 1.5x-2x market

statements.quote: We are moving steadily towards our stated objective of exceeding 30% by FY 2030.
statements.target: Dividend payout ratio exceeding 30% by FY2030 (27.2% in FY26)

statements.quote: EHV is very much on track. Capacity is expected to come on stream by end of this calendar year. And in FY28 revenues, we can see some contribution from EHV capacity.
statements.target: EHV capacity commissioned by end of calendar 2026; revenue contribution beginning FY28

statements.quote: The annual sustainable operating margin is expected to remain in the mid- to high single digits over mid- to long term.
statements.target: EPC segment sustainable operating margin of mid- to high single digits
